items.title: What Does Ford Motor (F) Michigan Battery Lead Mean For Its EV Supply Chain?
items.summary: Ford Motor (NYSE:F) is under political fire over its use of Chinese battery technology at a Michigan plant that is already operating. General Motors is pushing sodium-ion battery research to build U.S. battery capacity and limit reliance on Chinese suppliers. The two Detroit automakers are intensifying efforts to secure domestic battery supply chains for future electric vehicle production. items.title: GM President Shrugs Off High Diesel Prices
items.summary: General Motors’ No. 2 executive shrugged off U.S. diesel-fuel prices that reached a record $6.52 a gallon last week, saying the runup was transient and demand for trucks with diesel engines remained strong.

items.title: GM, LG to make lower-cost EV battery cells in Tennessee
items.summary: DETROIT, Sept 29 (Reuters) - General Motors and battery partner LG Energy ‌will upgrade their Tennessee plant to ‌make lower-cost battery cells, the companies said Tuesday. The Ultium ​Cells joint-venture plant will be upgraded beginning later this year to manufacture lithium manganese-rich (LMR) prismatic battery cells for future GM electric vehicles.

items.title: Stellantis Falls 4% With Canadian Labor Standoff Unresolved; Ford and General Motors Dip
